account-locked: Akpọchiri akaụntụ nwa oge n'ihi ọtụtụ mbọ nbanye dara ada. Biko nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel bụ naanị maka SuperAdmin, na Ngalaba Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Site na WeKan dị na Weddy, Cloud Panel na-eje ozi ọtụtụ ngalaba WeKan site n'otu sava, nke ọ bụla nwere data nke ya. Na Ngalaba Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin na-ahazi ngalaba ndị ahụ na CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Site na igodo CloudFlare API, ngalaba nke mpaghara ya dị na akaụntụ CloudFlare gị na-enweta ndekọ DNS e ji proxy mee na asambodo CloudFlare Origin. Ngalaba ndị ọzọ na-enweta asambodo Let's Encrypt. A na-echekwa igodo ahụ na sava, a gaghị egosi ya ọzọ.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ọ dịghị igodo CloudFlare API echekwara: ngalaba ọ bụla na-enweta asambodo Let's Encrypt.
